# Bearing Calculators

> Free ISO 281 bearing calculators for procurement engineers and maintenance teams — dimensions, life calculations, brand interchange, and Chinese supplier quotes.

Bearing Calculators provides accurate, browser-based tools for bearing selection, life calculation, brand cross-reference, and fit analysis. Dimensional data is sourced from ISO 15:2017, manufacturer catalogs (SKF, FAG, NSK, NTN, KOYO, Timken), and verified against multiple sources.

## Calculators

- [Bearing Life Calculator](https://bearingcalculators.com/bearing-life-calculator/): ISO 281 L10 bearing life — input dynamic load rating C, equivalent load P, and RPM to get L10 hours. Ball and roller bearings.
- [Bearing Interchange](https://bearingcalculators.com/bearing-interchange/): Cross-reference SKF, FAG, NSK, NTN, KOYO, NACHI, Timken model numbers. Find exact equivalents and Chinese (C&U, LYC, HRB, ZWZ) alternatives.
- [Bearing Fit Calculator](https://bearingcalculators.com/bearing-calculator/): ISO 286 shaft and housing fit analysis — clearance, transition, or interference fit with color-coded output.
- [Bearing Size Lookup](https://bearingcalculators.com/bearing-size-chart/): Look up bore, OD, width, and load ratings by model number, or reverse-search by dimensions.

## Reference

- [Bearing Size Chart](https://bearingcalculators.com/bearing-size-chart/): All 6200/6300/6000 series dimensions — bore, OD, width, C, C0.
- [Request a Quote](https://bearingcalculators.com/request-a-quote/): Get pricing from Chinese bearing manufacturers (C&U, LYC, HRB, ZWZ). FOB/CIF pricing available.

## Key Technical Facts

- Life calculation standard: ISO 281 (L10 basic rating life)
- Dimension standard: ISO 15:2017 (metric ball bearings)
- Supported series: 6200, 6300, 6000 deep groove ball bearings (MVP)
- Interchange coverage: SKF, FAG, NSK, NTN, KOYO, NACHI, Timken
- Chinese alternatives: C&U, LYC (Luoyang), HRB (Harbin), ZWZ (Zhejiang)
- Free to use, no registration required
